note: The weekly loop's challenger list (owner, 2026-11-12; agents/improver.md 'The weekly loop'). One Shorts challenger runs at a time against the champion recipe. The improver starts the top entry of the right kind when a verdict lands: cycles alternate 'first-second' (judged on stayed to watch) and 'look' (judged on held after the hook); after three cycles under 45% stayed to watch the next must be 'format'. Research and the auditor add entries with evidence; the owner's recipe notes go to the top of their kind. Done entries move to `history`.

challengers.test: 15-22 s Shorts (40-60 words, 4-5 beats) against the champion's 28-35 s
challengers.why: the growing fact channel in our niche runs 15-20 s; our Shorts of 27 s or less had the best 48 h views (n=5)

challengers.test: every beat shows one thing filling at least half the frame, against several small things
challengers.why: the 9-10 Nov Shorts lost viewers on frames with two text buttons or small icons

challengers.test: no cast member on screen unless the story is about them: the subject and the money only
challengers.why: the cast stood beside Magic Johnson's story with no part in it

challengers.test: something new on screen every 1.5 s against 2.5 s
challengers.why: growing Shorts cut far faster than ours

challengers.test: big one-to-three-word captions in the middle (the October style) against the sentence box
challengers.why: every 1K Short in October had them

challengers.test: topics from everyday brands people use (Costco, McDonald's, Netflix, gyms) against billionaires
challengers.why: how_they_make_money is our best story at 6.8x the median 48 h views (n=7)

challengers.test: no text chip standing in for a thing: every label sits on a drawn or real object
challengers.why: chips like 'LIFE INSURANCE' read as a slide

challengers.test: a parable series ('same start, four people, one ends up rich') against true-fact Shorts
challengers.why: The Curious Plot's story series turns viewers into subscribers (14.5K from 36 videos)
